mapper.select:
select status, priority, count(*) as task_count, sum(case when assignee_id = #{userId} then 1 else 0 end) as personal_count from task where del_flag = '0'
and (creator_id = #{viewerId} or assignee_id = #{viewerId})
and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by status, priority

select t.*, a.nick_name as assignee_name, c.nick_name as creator_name from task t left join sys_user a on a.user_id = t.assignee_id left join sys_user c on c.user_id = t.creator_id where t.del_flag = '0'
and (t.creator_id = #{viewerId} or t.assignee_id = #{viewerId})
and (locate(#{query.keyword}, t.title) > 0 or locate(#{query.keyword}, t.description) > 0)
and t.status = #{query.status} and t.priority = #{query.priority} and t.assignee_id = #{query.assigneeId}
order by
t.update_time t.due_date field(t.priority, 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH') field(t.status, 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE') t.title t.create_time
ascdesc, t.id desc

select t.*
, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = t.assignee_id) as assignee_name , (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = t.creator_id) as creator_name
from task t where t.id = #{id} and t.del_flag = '0' for update

select l.id, l.task_id, l.operator_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(o.nick_name), ''), nullif(o.user_name, ''), l.operator_name) as operator_name, l.action, l.before_data, l.after_data, l.create_time, case l.action when 'STATUS' then coalesce(concat('状态由', case json_unquote(json_extract(l.before_data, '$.status')) when 'TODO' then '待办' when 'IN_PROGRESS' then '进行中' when 'DONE' then '已完成' end, '变更为', case json_unquote(json_extract(l.after_data, '$.status')) when 'TODO' then '待办' when 'IN_PROGRESS' then '进行中' when 'DONE' then '已完成' end), l.remark) when 'ASSIGN' then coalesce(concat('负责人由', coalesce(nullif(trim(b.nick_name), ''), nullif(b.user_name, ''), concat('用户', nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(l.before_data, '$.assigneeId')), 'null'))), '变更为', coalesce(nullif(trim(a.nick_name), ''), nullif(a.user_name, ''), concat('用户', nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(l.after_data, '$.assigneeId')), 'null')))), l.remark) else l.remark end as remark from task_log l left join sys_user o on o.user_id = l.operator_id left join sys_user b on b.user_id = json_unquote(json_extract(l.before_data, '$.assigneeId')) left join sys_user a on a.user_id = json_unquote(json_extract(l.after_data, '$.assigneeId')) where l.task_id = #{taskId} order by l.create_time asc, l.id asc
select user_id, user_name, nick_name from sys_user where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by user_id
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' for share
mapper.insert: insert into task (title, description, priority, status, assignee_id, creator_id, due_date, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assigneeId}, #{creatorId}, #{dueDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag})
mapper.update: update task set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_time = #{deletedTime} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into task_log (task_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, before_data, after_data, remark, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
